description: This file is a Spring MVC controller class named DigitalProductController responsible for managing digital products in a web-based e-commerce admin interface. It handles operations such as viewing, saving/uploading digital product files, and deleting digital product entries. The controller methods interact with services to perform CRUD operations on digital products linked to products in the catalog.

classes.name: DigitalProductController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing digital product uploads, retrieval, and deletion in the admin panel.

methods.name: getDigitalProduct
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display a digital product details page, retrieving the digital product info by product ID.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload and save digital product files, associating uploaded files with the product.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a digital product file given its ID, with validation of store ownership.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set menu attributes for the view.
